metadata.title: Point-in-Time Integration Architecture & Historical Evaluation Plan
metadata.author: Senior Financial Data Engineer & Model Risk Validator

tier_1_raw_landing_zone.format: Immutable raw payload (JSON/CSV/XML) + SHA256 sidecar manifest
tier_1_raw_landing_zone.governance: Cryptographically signed; legal license metadata required before write.

tier_2_staged_validated.schema_enforcement: Point-in-Time Data Contract v1.0.0 schema applied
tier_2_staged_validated.quality_filtering: Passed all 10 Data Quality Rules (DQ_RULE_01 to DQ_RULE_10)

tier_3_point_in_time_feature_mart.point_in_time_enforcement: Features joined strictly where T_avail <= T_pred
tier_3_point_in_time_feature_mart.leakage_safeguard: Delta T reporting delay explicitly added to observation timestamps.

statistical_power_analysis.objective: Determine minimum sudden distress events required to validate candidate sensitivity superiority.
statistical_power_analysis.conclusion: Statistical power requires at least 35 sudden distress cases to reliably confirm a 60% sensitivity gain under the 8% alert budget.

audit_of_existing_t13_to_t14_cohort_limi.cohort_identifier: Tehran SME Panel (Dataset A) T=13 to T=14 transition
critical_limitations: EXHAUSTED_RESEARCH_SAMPLE: Cohort repeatedly evaluated across Phases 6.4, 6.4.1, 6.4.2, 6.4.3, 6.5, and 6.6.
CIRCULAR_OVERFITTING_RISK: Any model optimized on this specific cohort represents retrospective data snooping, not confirmatory testing.
INSUFFICIENT_STATISTICAL_POWER: With only 5 sudden failure cases, a single misclassification shifts recall by 20.0 percentage points.
UNVERIFIED_FOR_PROMOTION: Cannot be used as an untouched confirmatory holdout under Federal Reserve SR 11-7 standards.
audit_of_existing_t13_to_t14_cohort_limi.confirmatory_claim_prohibition: Confirmatory performance claims based on the T13-to-T14 cohort are strictly prohibited.

requirements_for_prospective_evaluation_.untouched_quarantine: Prospective cohort must remain strictly sequestered in cold storage until model architecture is frozen.
requirements_for_prospective_evaluation_.reporting_lag_simulation: Systematic lag testing across Delta T in [15d, 30d, 60d, 90d, 180d].
requirements_for_prospective_evaluation_.right_censored_treatment: Firms exiting observation without distress within 12 months must be censored, not marked non-distressed.
